# PROPHUNT LLP

> PROPHUNT LLP is a real estate channel partner in Baner, Pune, India, registered with MahaRERA (A52100037156, under MahaRERA's real estate agent category). It helps homebuyers and NRIs compare new, RERA-registered projects from established developers across West Pune (Baner, Wakad, Hinjewadi, Mahalunge, Tathawade, Balewadi), Pimpri-Chinchwad, Hadapsar, Sinhagad Road, Ravet and second-home markets such as Karjat and Khopoli. There is no advisory fee for buyers.

Office: Work Katta, 291/3, Pancard Club Road, Baner Gaon, Baner, Pune 411069. Phone +91 70668 80808. Email info@prophuntllp.com.

Project pages show the MahaRERA registration number, developer-published prices and unit sizes where the developer publishes them, and MahaRERA completion dates, with the date the facts were checked.

- [How we research and check our guides](https://www.prophuntllp.com/how-we-research): sources used (MahaRERA, IGR Maharashtra, official sites, developer sites), how project facts are verified, dates and corrections
